family: Delta Electronics BFB0524HH 50 x 50 x 15 mm centrifugal blower, 24 V
source_level: maker's specification for approval (vendor_docs/delta_BFB0524HH_spec.pdf, 7 pages, rev A00, 2003-10-28) and the maker's STEP (vendor_cad/inbox/BFB0524HH.step)

values.size_note: bounding box of the maker's STEP (X width, Y thickness, Z height); the drawing (p.6) gives 51.0 x 51.3 x 15.0 for the body
values.step_frame: the STEP's own axes, its bounding box centred at the origin: X across the face, Y the thickness, Z up the face; the outlet on the +Z edge at X 6.5 .. 26.3, air leaving along +Z

mount_holes.note: 2 x dia 4.5 +/-0.3 (drawing p.6); positions measured on the STEP, in the frame above (X, Z)

outlet_mm.note: drawing p.6: outlet 20.0 +/-0.5 long, 12.2 across the 15 mm thickness (1.8 and 1.0 walls); placed on the STEP by the holes' pattern (the STEP is the drawing's front view turned 90 degrees)

pq_curve_cfm_pa.basis: read by eye from the maker's P&Q curve at 24 V (spec p.5; mmH2O x 9.807), about +/-1 mmH2O and +/-0.1 CFM
